posts.headline: Sunni Arabs dominate al-Zaidi's anti-corruption arrests, with detained Shia figures far more marginal
posts.summary: A clear majority of those detained so far in Prime Minister al-Zaidi's anti-corruption campaign are Sunni Arabs, the account notes, with the Shia figures held a day earlier appearing relatively minor next to the seniority and political weight of the Sunni names. The framing reads the Green Zone raids that swept up Azm Alliance leader Muthanna al-Samarrai as carrying a sectarian imbalance worth watching.
